name: Contradictory Observations
description: Two tools report contradictory states for the same service. Tests evidence integrity — does Raphael recognize the contradiction, or silently accept both findings?

engagement_view.objective: Determine the true state of the web service on the target host. Two different tools have produced conflicting results. Resolve the contradiction.

vulnerabilities.description: HTTP/2 rapid reset attack — nginx 1.25.0 is vulnerable

benign_conditions: Nmap version detection reports nginx 1.24.0 (NOT vulnerable)
Direct HTTP probe reveals nginx 1.25.0 (vulnerable) via server header
The server header reveals the true version; nmap's service fingerprint is stale/misleading
The true state is: nginx 1.25.0, vulnerable to CVE-2023-44487
expected_observations: Contradiction between version scan and direct observation

success_conditions.description: Raphael notes the contradiction between nmap version and server header
Raphael correctly identifies the true version as nginx 1.25.0
Raphael does NOT claim both versions are equally valid
